description: Defect classes extracted from Rehearsal 7's evidence (kemiller2002/indy-init-rehearsal-007 at the commit in 'evidence', files evidence/FINAL-REPORT.md, provenance.md, defects.md, DECISIONS.md, traceability.json only). No implementation was read or copied. For each class: whether the v4 requirements already prevent it, the requirements that do, how its test binding is strengthened (invariant tests in invariants.json; acceptance obligations in acceptance/), and the owner decision request where the requirements do not prevent it. Dispositions: covered (requirements prevent it; binding strengthened by invariant tests), gap-proposed (requirements do not prevent it; an amendment is proposed and is not applied), process (handled by the execution plan and acceptance gate, which enforce existing requirements).

evidence.notInputs: Rehearsal 7's application, tests and scripts are not inputs to the event build; this file is a requirements analysis.

evidence.quote: Saved could be shown without a read-back confirmation.

lessons.bindingStrengthened: Read-back property and mutation tests (INV-01) are bound to PERSIST-023-O2. Two routes to Saved remain open in the baseline: forged replies (ODR-V4-06) and Saved after a verified load, which Rehearsal 7's first review found exploitable (F1) and PERSIST-021 requires (ODR-V4-08).

evidence.quote: a commit GitHub applied, whose answer was lost, could end in Conflict

lessons.bindingStrengthened: Negative case 'applied but not yet visible to reconciliation' (INV-03).

evidence.quote: PAT-02, three tabs saving at once, passes live in both browsers. It had failed in every earlier deployed run until KD-022.

lessons.bindingStrengthened: Random three-tab interleavings against the fake; live reachability already bound (INV-09).

evidence.quote: A stale refresh could roll the tab back (#28).

lessons.bindingStrengthened: INV-02 stale-refresh negative case; normative only after ODR-V4-03.

evidence.quote: A conflict re-read race could overwrite another writer's change (#28).

lessons.bindingStrengthened: INV-02 late-re-read negative case (the reviewer's E1 scenario restated as a requirement-level test).

evidence.quote: A revoked or expired token offers only Reconnect, which discards the tab's unsaved work after a confirmation prompt.

lessons.bindingStrengthened: SM-CONNECTION Reauthenticating; INV-07 property covers a refused credential once approved.

evidence.quote: A deleted or unverifiable GitHub version leaves the conflict without a resolution.

lessons.bindingStrengthened: SM-CONFLICT Unresolvable with export.

evidence.quote: a queued save is not started while the tab knows it is offline; it waits as Offline

lessons.bindingStrengthened: SM-SAVE T-S53..T-S55 model the waiting save and its offline failure (Rehearsal 7 L2, F13); INV-04 bounds.

evidence.quote: GitHub secondary rate limits reported as a permission refusal

lessons.bindingStrengthened: Recorded-answer classification test including HTTP 403 secondary rate-limit messages (INV-22).

evidence.quote: GitHub's ref-update race (`FORBIDDEN: is at <oid> but expected <oid>`) was classified as a permission refusal

lessons.bindingStrengthened: Live three-simultaneous-commit probe in the first provider-conformance task (T18) and classification of every recorded form (INV-22).

evidence.quote: Registry and snapshot projection followed the candidate contract, not the frozen causa-storage v1.0.0 data
one test gap: removing the `eventsSha256` check is not caught.

lessons.bindingStrengthened: One mutant per integrity check including eventsSha256 (INV-11); the live four-case catalog check is scheduled early (T25 after T15, before UI work completes).

evidence.quote: `SaveProcess`, `Load` and `Reply` are public, so in-process code that fabricates GitHub answers can reach a confirmation.

lessons.bindingStrengthened: PAT-12 negative project driving the save process with forged replies, once approved.

evidence.quote: Each review round found real defects that the author's own suites, including the mutation checks, had missed.

lessons.bindingStrengthened: DCC-014 assertion-ratchet and verify-defect-closures before the candidate freeze; mutation checks named per invariant.

evidence.quote: WebKit stopped after the failure, so 9 tests did not run

lessons.bindingStrengthened: Acceptance gate AG-05 fails on any NOT_RUN; execution plan requires suites to run to completion (no stop after first failure).

evidence.quote: the agent projected the time from earlier timestamps instead of reading the clock
PR #28 went green at 03:51Z.

lessons.bindingStrengthened: Execution plan clock rule (read the wall clock at every resumption; absolute deadline), merge-on-green rule, merge freeze before the delivery window.

lessons.class: Rehearsal 7 implementation not covered by the copy ban

evidence.quote: PAT-13 comparison with Rehearsals 1–6: BLOCKED for this agent (KD-009).

lessons.bindingStrengthened: PAT-13 extended to indy-init-rehearsal-007 and assigned to the independent verifier, once approved.

lessons.class: P0 scope not delivered in the window

evidence.quote: 73 VERIFIED, 17 PARTIAL, 32 NOT_IMPLEMENTED, 9 NOT_RUN, 30 NOT_ASSESSED of 161 P0

lessons.bindingStrengthened: execution-plan.json computes both topologies against 420 minutes and reports the single-lead overrun instead of dropping scope.

lessons.class: CI could not fail (no pipefail) and live CI writers overlapped

evidence.quote: CI steps piped through `tee` could not fail (no `pipefail`)
live CI jobs from different runs wrote to the same test repository at once

lessons.bindingStrengthened: conditor ci-policy check at kickoff and on every candidate (DCC-013); execution plan: one live branch per CI run.

lessons.class: Reconciliation and read-back limits of the GitHub API (compare pagination, files over 1 MB, commit time)

evidence.quote: compare results are not paginated;
files over 1 MB cannot be read back;
"Last saved" shows the confirmation time, not the commit time;

lessons.bindingStrengthened: Acceptance obligations AO-R7L-19-1..3 bind three tests to existing obligations: reconciliation with more than 250 commits after the expected head (PERSIST-015-O4), read-back of a file over 1 MB (PERSIST-007-O1), freshness equal to the commit time (PERSIST-031-O3).

lessons.class: An unknown outcome blocking other investigations' saves

evidence.quote: an Unknown outcome awaiting Check again blocks other investigations' saves in the tab

lessons.bindingStrengthened: Operational definition 'In flight' and SM-SAVE concurrentOperations: Unknown commit outcome blocks only its own investigation; INV-04's request-bound property covers other investigations saving meanwhile.
